import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CodeForce308C {
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = in.readLine().split("\\s+");
        long w = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        long m = Long.parseLong(input[1]);
        
        // Convert m to balance problem: we need to represent m as sum of w^i * c_i where c_i ∈ {-1, 0, 1}
        // -1 means weight on same side as item, 1 means weight on opposite side, 0 means not used
        
        long current = m;
        while (current > 0) {
            long remainder = current % w;
            
            // remainder should be 0, 1, or w-1 (which represents -1 in balanced representation)
            if (remainder == 0) {
                current = current / w;
            } else if (remainder == 1) {
                current = current / w;
            } else if (remainder == w - 1) {
                // This means we put a weight on the same side as the item (equivalent to -1)
                current = current / w + 1;
            } else {
                // Cannot represent with balanced ternary-like system
                System.out.println("NO");
                return;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println("YES");
    }
}
